topic: VRRP配对参数与非抢占配置工件
title: 交付一致的Keepalived单播配对配置并执行原生检查
source: 飞书《60》技术问题改编并纠错
review_note: 独立本地验收：参考产物通过，初始产物和典型错误实现未通过；真实集群和外部服务不在本轮执行范围。
body:
## 环境与初始材料
普通Linux用户、Keepalived2.2和ip。提供两份配置模板；192.0.2.0/24是文档示例地址，不会分配到机器接口。仅运行config-test，不启动Keepalived服务。

## 操作任务
交付primary.conf和secondary.conf，采用IPv4单播VRRP配对：共同实例APP、VRID51、VIP192.0.2.100/32、advert_int=1；主机源地址分别192.0.2.10/.11，各自unicast_peer必须指向对方而不是自己。优先级分别150/100。两端初始state均为BACKUP并配置nopreempt，避免配置意图上恢复后自动抢回。接口保留{{IFACE}}占位符。只允许题定实例与参数，不加入include、通知脚本、静态路由或其他实例。

## 提交产物
primary.conf、secondary.conf两份可交付配置；验收生成.rendered副本做原生离线检查，保持原工件不变。

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py把接口替换为当前可读接口名，分别运行真实keepalived --config-test，另用非法VRID负控确认解析器确实拒错；对两份工件进行源/对端交叉核对，检查相同VRID/VIP、不同优先级、初始BACKUP与nopreempt语义组合。验收前后地址和路由快照必须不变。全部通过退出0；没有启动守护进程、发VRRP通告或添加VIP，因此不证明主备选举、ARP更新或故障切换成功。

失败示例：两份文件各自都能被解析，不代表它们能配对；备用节点unicast_peer误指向自己会被交叉契约拒绝。
rubric: 源地址与对端成对一致且VIP/VRID正确
非抢占配置工件明确，不冒充真实切换验证

test_files.checks/check.py:
import pathlib,shlex,socket,subprocess,json
root=pathlib.Path.cwd();interface=next(name for _,name in socket.if_nameindex() if name!='lo')
def parse(text):
    # Contract grammar permits ordinary whitespace and #/! comments, but no includes or executable directives.
    lines=[]
    for line in text.splitlines():
        line=line.split('#',1)[0].split('!',1)[0]
        if line.strip():lines.append(line)
    lexer=shlex.shlex('\n'.join(lines),posix=True,punctuation_chars='{}');lexer.whitespace_split=True;tokens=list(lexer)
    assert tokens[:3]==['vrrp_instance','APP','{'] and tokens[-1]=='}'
    data={};i=3
    while i<len(tokens)-1:
        key=tokens[i];i+=1;assert key not in data,'duplicate directive'
        if key in ('unicast_peer','virtual_ipaddress'):
            assert tokens[i]=='{';i+=1;values=[]
            while tokens[i]!='}':values.append(tokens[i]);i+=1
            i+=1;data[key]=values
        elif key=='nopreempt':data[key]=True
        else:
            assert key in ('state','interface','virtual_router_id','priority','advert_int','unicast_src_ip'),'out-of-scope directive'
            data[key]=tokens[i];i+=1
    assert i==len(tokens)-1
    return data
before_addr=subprocess.check_output(['ip','-j','addr','show'],text=True)
before_route=subprocess.check_output(['ip','-j','route','show','table','all'],text=True)
records=[]
for index,name in enumerate(('primary.conf','secondary.conf')):
    original=(root/name).read_text();assert '{{IFACE}}' in original
    text=original.replace('{{IFACE}}',interface);data=parse(text)
    assert set(data)=={'state','interface','virtual_router_id','priority','advert_int','nopreempt','unicast_src_ip','unicast_peer','virtual_ipaddress'}
    assert data['state']=='BACKUP' and data['interface']==interface and data['nopreempt'] is True
    assert data['virtual_router_id']=='51' and data['advert_int']=='1'
    assert data['priority']==('150' if index==0 else '100')
    assert data['unicast_src_ip']==('192.0.2.10' if index==0 else '192.0.2.11')
    assert data['virtual_ipaddress']==['192.0.2.100/32']
    path=root/(name+'.rendered');path.write_text(text)
    run=subprocess.run(['keepalived','--config-test','--use-file='+str(path),'--log-console','--no-syslog'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=4)
    assert run.returncode==0,(run.returncode,run.stderr)
    assert (root/name).read_text()==original
    records.append(data)
assert records[0]['unicast_peer']==[records[1]['unicast_src_ip']]
assert records[1]['unicast_peer']==[records[0]['unicast_src_ip']]
assert records[0]['virtual_router_id']==records[1]['virtual_router_id']
assert records[0]['virtual_ipaddress']==records[1]['virtual_ipaddress']
assert before_addr==subprocess.check_output(['ip','-j','addr','show'],text=True)
assert before_route==subprocess.check_output(['ip','-j','route','show','table','all'],text=True)
# Retain a native parser negative control, distinct from cross-file consistency checks.
bad=(root/'primary.conf.rendered').read_text().replace('virtual_router_id 51','virtual_router_id invalid')
(root/'parser-negative.conf').write_text(bad)
run=subprocess.run(['keepalived','--config-test','--use-file='+str(root/'parser-negative.conf'),'--no-syslog'],capture_output=True,timeout=4)
assert run.returncode!=0,'native config-test failed to reject invalid VRID'
